name: Cosmic Integration
body:
School transmutation [void]; Level psychic 8, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 8

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range personal

Target self

Duration 1 round/level

Void: Spells with this descriptor are tied with a philosophical school of magic based on a concept known as the Void. The school teaches that the Void is the nothingness from which springs forth creativity, insight, spirit, thought, and also the source of pure energy from which all elements and phenomena are derived. Channeling the power of the Void (or the Void element) allows for the manipulation of the elements in objects and creatures, among other possibilities. Spells with the void descriptor are considered to belong to the Void element (for geomancers) and the void elemental school (for void elementalists).

If a spell has the [void] descriptor, it cannot be dispelled by elements release regardless of how high is your CL.

Your consciousness and form temporarily fuses with the essence of the Void in a controlled state. You gain SR equal to 15 + your caster level and your type changes to outsider with the incorporeal and native subtypes. You gain all of the benefits of the incorporeal subtype but you remain visible. If this spell ends and you become corporeal while inside a material object (such as a solid wall), you are shunted off to the nearest open space, taking 1d6 points of damage per 5 feet traveled in this way.

You also gain 1d4 + 1 temporary ki points that are used first and any remaining points are lost when the spell ends.

Finally, while this spell lasts, you may cast spells as if affected by a cosmic intermediary spell.
